title: Kusanagi Nene — Getting You Snacks〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Shopping Mall - Grocery Store
se_walk_women_002_1
se_walk_women_002_2

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Nene! Nene!
They've got some new flavors of chips out!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Ochazuke and meat-and-potato-stew flavors...? I can sorta guess what they taste like, but... They put out some weird flavors.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I might buy a bag♪
Which flavor do you wanna try, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Honestly, I don't really care...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Also, try not to forget that we're here today to buy things for Rui.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I know♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Rui's working really hard on his show, so we're gonna support him by bringing him some goodies☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, he seemed pretty stuck until a couple days ago, but I think he's found his heading now.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: On the other hand, now that he knows what to do, he's been working nonstop.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, he mentioned how his schedule's really tight!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
There's also that...
But even without that, Rui tends to hyperfocus on what's in front of him.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I have a feeling that he's working so hard that he's forgetting to eat.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No, that means he's gonna collapse due to starvation!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Which is why we need to get him some food that he can munch on while he works.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Right! Let's try to find stuff that he'll really like!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's see... Things he can have while he works...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, what about instant noodles?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Instant noodles...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Do you think he'd eat that?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hmm... He might see boiling water as too much of a hassle.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Which means he'll just keep working instead of eating them.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then, frozen foods are no good either, right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: All he'd have to do is use the microwave, but he probably won't eat anything that involves leaving his room.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I think he'll need food that's ready to eat without any prep.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I know! What about candy?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, your brain does need sugar.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: In that case, we should get some of those!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The candy that Rui loves the most!

rows.Speaker: Nene & Emu
rows.Line:
Soda candy.
Soda candy!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: He'd love that, so let's get some for him.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Alright, the candy aisle should be... Oh, this should be it! Look at the shelves!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Soda♪ Soda♪ Where's the yummy soda candy♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, they're here at the bottom.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wow, they have a lot of different kinds.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Grape, strawberry and soda flavors...
Oh, some are even shaped like stars and flowers!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Which should we get?
I think the ones he usually gets are these, so...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Avalanche☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, what...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
You put in way too much!
They're falling out of the basket...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We should give him all of these!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I want Rui to work hard and be full of energy, so he should have as much soda candy as he can♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sure, but this still seems like way too much...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: If we were to give him all these, he'd...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Actually, he might be happy...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really?! That means we can get all these for him, right?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hmm... Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But giving him a pile of soda candy might cause him to eat nothing else. So, we should also look for other stuff.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Things that are a little healthier, like nutritional snacks...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay☆ Then, let's head over this way to our next stop!
